overview:
**Low fire danger continues across the Montrose high-elevation area, held down by cold, moist air and shallow fuels.**
- The week-ahead outlook holds steady at Low danger through November 30, with ERC easing slightly from 39% to 33%.
- A cold, dry pattern persists, with lows near 13°F tonight and highs staying in the 30s-40s; winds stay light (5-13 mph) out of the NE.
- 0 of 7 local watchout thresholds are met today, and no Red Flag Warning or other NWS alerts are active for the area.
- No county or BLM/Forest Service fire restrictions are currently reported in effect across the Gunnison, Uncompahgre, or Montrose-area jurisdictions.
- No active wildfires are reported in or near this area's counties; the only uncontained large fire in the national sit report is the Foot Creek Fire in Wyoming, well outside this region.
